circle_method_check.note: Leading term of Hardy-Littlewood circle method.

minor_arc_note: Minor arc bound is unconditional for ternary Goldbach (Helfgott 2013). For binary Goldbach, Vinogradov minor arc bound requires GRH or remains conditional.
claim: The major arc contribution to r(N) is positive for all large even N. Binary Goldbach closure conditional on minor arc bound.
